title: Integrated serum pharmacochemistry, network pharmacology and transcriptomics reveals the mechanism of Periploca forrestii on rheumatoid arthritis bone erosion.
authors: Dong, Minghong; Song, Da; Yang, Min; Liu, Xiongwei; Feng, Tingting; Liu, Chang; Zhou, Ying
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药杠柳治疗类风湿关节炎骨侵蚀的药理机制，涉及信号通路和分子对接，但核心是药物作用而非蛋白质-DNA互作，无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Periploca forrestii Schltr. (PF), classified among the "Ten Major Miao Medicinal Herbs" of Guizhou, China, has been traditionally used in Miao medicine to treat fractures and rheumatoid arthritis (RA), in accordance with the principle of "using vines to alleviate obstruction-related pain." However, the mechanism underlying its bone-protective effects, particularly regarding bone metabolism regulation in RA, remains incompletely elucidated. AIM OF THE STUDY: To investigate the potential pharmacodynamic material basis and mechanisms of PF against RA-associated bone erosion by integrating serum pharmacochemistry, network pharmacology, and transcriptomics, with in vivo experimental validation, thereby providing scientific evidence for its traditional application. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Chemical constituents of PF and its plasma-absorbed components were characterized using UPLC-Q-TOF-MS and GNPS molecular networking, while potential targets and pathways were predicted through network pharmacology. The anti-arthritic and bone-protective effects were assessed in a collagen-induced arthritis (CIA) rat model via Micro-CT, histopathology, and immunohistochemistry. Key targets within the RANKL-RANK-OPG axis and BMP2-SMAD signaling pathway were further validated by transcriptomics, Western blot, immunohistochemistry and molecular docking. RESULTS: Fifty-three compounds were identified from PF. In the serum of PF-treated CIA rats, 57 compounds were detected in the serum of CIA rats treated with PF, mainly caffeoylquinic acids and steroids, comprising 8 prototype components and 49 metabolites. Integrated network pharmacology and transcriptomics analysis indicated that PF alleviates bone destruction in RA by inhibiting osteoclast differentiation and promoting osteoblast differentiation. In CIA rats, PF treatment markedly reduced joint swelling and lowered serum levels of pro-inflammatory cytokines such as IL-1beta, IL-6, and TNF-alpha. Micro-CT, Safranin O staining, and TRAP staining, together with upregulated ALP mRNA and OCN protein expression, collectively confirmed that PF mitigates bone erosion. Moreover, IHC, RT-qPCR, and Western blot analyses revealed that PF effectively decreased the RANKL/OPG ratio in ankle tissues while significantly suppressing RANK and its key downstream transcription factor NFATc1. PF also restored the diminished levels of BMP-2, SMAD1, p-SMAD1, and SMAD4 in CIA rats and normalized the abnormally elevated RUNX2 protein. These findings demonstrate that PF ameliorates bone erosion in CIA rats via a multi-targeted and bidirectional regulatory mechanism, simultaneously inhibiting osteoclast differentiation and enhancing osteoblast activity. CONCLUSION: PF alleviates bone erosion in CIA rats by inhibiting osteoclast differentiation and promoting osteogenic differentiation through modulation of the RANKL-RANK-OPG and BMP2-SMAD signaling pathways. This finding validates its traditional use for bone protection.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：杠柳（Periploca for forrestii Schltr.，PF）被列为中国贵州“十大苗药”之一，在苗医中传统上用于治疗骨折和类风湿关节炎（RA），遵循“以藤通络止痛”的原则。然而，其骨保护作用的机制，特别是对RA中骨代谢调节的作用，尚未完全阐明。研究目的：通过整合血清药物化学、网络药理学和转录组学，并进行体内实验验证，探讨PF抗RA相关骨侵蚀的药效物质基础及潜在机制，为其传统应用提供科学依据。材料与方法：利用UPLC-Q-TOF-MS和GNPS分子网络对PF的化学成分及其血浆吸收成分进行表征，通过网络药理学预测潜在靶点和通路。在胶原诱导性关节炎（CIA）大鼠模型中，通过Micro-CT、组织病理学和免疫组织化学评估抗关节炎和骨保护作用。通过转录组学、Western blot、免疫组织化学和分子对接进一步验证RANKL-RANK-OPG轴和BMP2-SMAD信号通路中的关键靶点。结果：从PF中鉴定出53种化合物。在PF处理的CIA大鼠血清中，检测到57种化合物，主要为咖啡酰奎宁酸和甾体类，包括8种原型成分和49种代谢产物。综合网络药理学和转录组学分析表明，PF通过抑制破骨细胞分化和促进成骨细胞分化来缓解RA中的骨破坏。在CIA大鼠中，PF治疗显著减轻关节肿胀，并降低血清中促炎细胞因子如IL-1β、IL-6和TNF-α的水平。Micro-CT、番红O染色和TRAP染色，以及ALP mRNA和OCN蛋白表达的上调，共同证实PF减轻骨侵蚀。此外，IHC、RT-qPCR和Western blot分析显示，PF有效降低踝关节组织中的RANKL/OPG比值，同时显著抑制RANK及其关键下游转录因子NFATc1。PF还恢复了CIA大鼠中BMP-2、SMAD1、p-SMAD1和SMAD4的降低水平，并使异常升高的RUNX2蛋白正常化。这些发现表明，PF通过多靶点和双向调节机制改善CIA大鼠的骨侵蚀，同时抑制破骨细胞分化和增强成骨细胞活性。结论：PF通过调节RANKL-RANK-OPG和BMP2-SMAD信号通路，抑制破骨细胞分化和促进成骨分化，从而减轻CIA大鼠的骨侵蚀。这一发现验证了其传统上用于骨保护的用途。
